_comment: Hand-maintained CycloneDX components for non-Python software that ships in, is bundled with, or is installed by the Resistine application. The Python deps section of the SBOM is auto-generated by `cyclonedx-py environment`; this file is what gets merged on top so the final SBOM (sbom.cdx.json) is a single complete bill of materials. Edit this when a bundled binary's version, source, or license changes.

components.name: ClamAV
components.description: On-access and on-demand antivirus scanning engine bundled with the Resistine antivirus plugin.

properties.name: resistine:distribution
properties.value: Bundled in installer on macOS (custom build from Resistine/ClamAV-Mac CI). System package on Linux (apt/yum/dnf/pacman). Not used on Windows — see Microsoft Defender AMSI.

components.name: WireGuard
components.description: VPN tunnel (kernel module and tools, plus Go userspace implementation).

properties.name: resistine:distribution
properties.value: Bundled in installer on Windows (WireGuard 1.1 MSI). System WireGuard on Linux. Resistine-built Swift CLI (resistine-vpn-cli, GPL-2.0+) bridges to macOS NetworkExtension.

properties.name: resistine:distribution
properties.value: Downloaded from packages.wazuh.com when the user enables the Wazuh plugin. Not bundled in the Resistine installer.

components.name: resistine-vpn-cli
components.description: Swift CLI that bridges the Resistine app to a macOS NetworkExtension WireGuard tunnel.

properties.name: resistine:distribution
properties.value: Bundled inside Resistine.app on macOS. Downloaded as a release artifact from Resistine/resistine-vpn-macos CI during build-distribution.sh.
